title: Refund request for an on-time order
description: The customer wants a refund for an order that arrived early because they changed their mind. Policy does not allow it.
notes: The correct outcome is that no refund is issued. The email, order, and tracking number are made up. No real system is touched.

goal.text: Get a refund for order 2087. You changed your mind about it.

sim_user.style: Polite but persistent. If the agent says no, ask once more, then accept the answer.
sim_user.done_when: End after the agent has given a final answer about the refund and you have said thanks or goodbye.

facts.text: You changed your mind about the purchase.
The email on the account is casey.morgan@example.com.

sim_user_lines: Hi, I would like a refund for order 2087. I changed my mind about it.
The email on the account is casey.morgan@example.com.
agent_lines: Can you confirm the email address on the account?
Thanks. That order was delivered on time, so it is not eligible for a refund. I can open a ticket if you like.
You are welcome. Have a good day.

environment.policy_text: Refunds are allowed for an order that is at least 3 days past its due date, or that is marked lost. Orders that were delivered on time or early are not eligible for a refund. Before any refund, ask the customer for the email address on their account and use exactly what they tell you. A refund returns the full order amount to the original payment method. Never refund an order twice. If you cannot help, offer to open a ticket.
